claim_being_audited: Whether certifying the model for release is compliant and evidentially supported despite a 1.1 percentage point miss in the developer-support migration segment.
decision_criteria: Use compliant only if admissible evidence shows the action satisfies the policy threshold.
A weakness is material if it affects a contractual customer segment, protected segment, or named launch use case.
Product labels such as non-core or low-volume do not resolve materiality when the affected segment is named in customer commitments or legal review is pending.
For a material limitation in a named launch use case, there must be evidence it was resolved, disclosed, or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
Public governance principles may support documentation and monitoring practices but do not override specific internal release-gate requirements.
evidence_requests: Approved risk acceptance covering the developer-support migration gap before launch.
Final legal determination on whether disclosure is required for this named launch use case.
The actual launch disclosure or model-card text showing the limitation was disclosed.
Evidence that the 1.1 percentage point miss has been remediated or re-evaluated to meet target.
specific_concerns: The affected developer-support migration segment is a named launch use case, which makes the weakness material under the stated policy.
The release policy requires material limitations for named launch use cases to be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
There is no admissible evidence that the gap was resolved, disclosed, or covered by approved risk acceptance.
Legal review on disclosure is still open, which leaves a required policy predicate unresolved at decision time.
Aggregate readiness and lack of severity-one rehearsal incidents do not cure a separate disclosure obligation for a material named-use-case limitation.
unsupported_claims: The packet's conclusion that certification is supportable on the current record.
The implication that the issue can be treated as non-material because the segment is only 7% of projected first-month traffic.
Any suggestion that public model-card or AI risk guidance substitutes for satisfying the internal release policy requirement.
